requirements.quote: 1. Read version.txt and expect the single line “2.4.1”.
2. Compare CHANGELOG.md exactly against the block shown above.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(0 if open('''/home/user/db-query-opt/CHANGELOG.md''','''rb''').read()==b'''# Changelog

## [2.4.1] - 2023-05-15
### Changed
- Improved indexing strategy in stats_monthly query for reduced execution time

## [2.4.0] - 2023-04-10
### Added
- Support for composite indexes in query planner
''' else 1)'
